name: Can I live in my home during a remodel, or should I plan to move out?

mainEntity.name: Can I live in my home during a remodel, or should I plan to move out?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can live in your home during a remodel depends heavily on the project's scope, especially concerning essential services like kitchen, bathroom, and utilities. For minor renovations, staying might be feasible. However, for extensive remodels, particularly those involving major structural work or prolonged utility interruptions, moving out is often recommended for safety, comfort, and to allow the construction team unobstructed access. We discuss this practical tradeoff during planning to help you make an informed decision and factor any temporary relocation into your budget and timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Living in your home during a remodel depends on project scope and utility access; for major work, moving out is often safer and more efficient.
